main_results_evidence_level: Measured CM results, named by initialization. Implementation provenance, seeds and target variants are separate metadata. No model reruns.
note: Numerical algebra checks are not new empirical model experiments or a replacement for the appendix proof.

metric_change.definition: Median over valid layer/task records of one minus the Frobenius cosine of the processed KL-G Kronecker metric between consecutive model states.
metric_change.display: logarithmic y-axis; colors match initialization panel
metric_change.normalization_proof_role: A theoretical comparison bound, not an ordinary-Fisher experiment.
